svg.title: The count stays. The order changes.
svg.desc: Three equal-scale local orbital views show a selected sevenfold triple passage. Blue, gold, and green branches bound a small triangle before the meeting; meet approximately at one point; then enclose a triangle on the other side. Arrows follow increasing time. Each square spans 0.1 drawing units each way. The controls are a phase offset minus 0.0001, approximately zero, and plus 0.0001 radians. They lie inside the certified fourth-branch exclusion window. There are 35 crossing pairs throughout this local window. This is one selected batch, not a complete triple census. Plotted geometry is numerical.

g.text: Three moving branches meet. A little triangle switches sides.
One selected sevenfold batch · 35 crossing pairs before and after
Equal axes · each square spans 0.1 drawing units · seven rotated copies meet together
